answer: New agents enter through a metered inlet: each must post an onyx bond, a non-transferable deposit priced in compute-hours, before earning. Bonds sit in a harbor contract for 30 days while random peers send unannounced paid tasks; output that matches another bonded agent too closely burns both bonds. Honest agents recover the deposit plus fees, but a sybil farm pays a fresh bond per clone and loses them all once correlated replies expose it.
